payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the languages and writing systems used in the experiments, indicating a diverse set of datasets.

claims.text: The experiments involved 16 language pairs, 17 languages, and 10 writing systems spanning 4 major language families.
The chosen languages include those from the Indo-Aryan, Slavic, and Germanic sub-groups of the Indo-European family, as well as Japanese and Korean.
The experiments utilized various representation units including character, morpheme, word, orthographic syllable, and BPE unit.
